codeQuality.summary: This README provides bare-bones documentation that covers only the absolute basics. While it includes essential sections (title, features, usage), it lacks critical information like prerequisites, installation steps, and detailed usage examples. The documentation would significantly benefit from expanded feature descriptions, setup instructions, and standard sections like Contributing and License. For a demo project showcasing code review workflows, the documentation itself could serve as a better example by being more comprehensive and following README best practices.

# Demo Todo App

A simple todo list application for demonstrating code review workflows.

## Prerequisites
- Node.js >= 14.0.0
- npm >= 6.0.0

## Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/chennagajula9999-glitch/demo-todo-app.git
cd demo-todo-app
npm install
```

## Features
- Add a todo item
- Remove a todo item
- View all todos
- Mark todos as complete

## Usage
```bash
node todo.js
```

## Project Structure
```
demo-todo-app/
├── todo.js          # Main application file
├── package.json     # Project dependencies
└── README.md        # Documentation
```

## Contributing
Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit a Pull Request.

## License
MIT License - see LICENSE file for details
